title: Herbal Light German Prawns Skewers
description: A light and fluffy German dish featuring raw frozen prawns, cooked in a fondue pot with herbal flavors and deglaze fond, suitable for an ayurvedic rajasic friendly diet.
instructions: Thread the prawns onto skewers, leaving a small space between each prawn.
Heat the olive oil in a fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the fondue pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine to the fondue pot and bring to a simmer.
Add the fond to the fondue pot and stir to combine.
Add the prawn skewers to the fondue pot and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Remove the prawn skewers from the fondue pot and place on a serving plate.
Stir in the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper into the fondue pot.
Serve the prawn skewers with the herbal sauce from the fondue pot spooned over the top.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley and dill over the top of the prawn skewers.
